sentences.english: Every employee deserves a headquarters.
sentences.japanese: すべての社員に本社を、

sentences.english: Now they have one.
sentences.japanese: それが今実現します。

sentences.english: Welcome to Workvivo HQ, the AI native employee experience platform where comms, knowledge, action, and insight come together in one connected experience.
sentences.japanese: WorkvivoHQへようこそ。コミュニケーション、ナレッジ、アクション、インサイト、そのすべてが一つにつながるAIネイティブの社員エクスペリエンスプラットフォームです。

sentences.english: Create tailored experiences for every role, team, and location with personalized homepage experiences.
sentences.japanese: パーソナライズされたホーム画面で、役割、チーム、拠点ごとに最適な体験を届けます。

sentences.english: Back from time off?
sentences.japanese: 休暇明けも

sentences.english: Catch up in an instant with personalized AI summaries.
sentences.japanese: パーソナライズされたAI要約ですぐにキャッチアップ。

sentences.english: Keep everyone informed, connected, and engaged through content that captures attention and drives engagement.
sentences.japanese: 思わず目を引くコンテンツで情報を届け、つながりを生み、エンゲージメントを高めます。

sentences.english: Celebrate success and recognize your best people with public shoutouts tied to company values.
sentences.japanese: 企業のバリューに紐づいた賞賛の投稿で、成果を称え、活躍する仲間を認め合う。

sentences.english: Create, refine, and localize content in seconds with AI that actually knows your people, culture, and tone of voice.
sentences.japanese: 自社の人文化トーンを理解したAIがコンテンツの作成、遂行、ローカライズを数秒で、

sentences.english: Connect leadership with your team in turn important moments into interactive experiences everyone can be part of.
sentences.japanese: 経営層と現場をリアルタイムにつなぎ、大切な瞬間を誰もが参加できる双方向の体験に、

sentences.english: Build stronger communities with dedicated spaces for collaboration, conversation, and connection.
sentences.japanese: コラボレーション、対話、つながりのための専用スペースで、コミュニティーをより強く、

sentences.english: Deliver personalized, timely AI-powered journeys that adapt to each employee, from onboarding to change rollouts.
sentences.japanese: オンボーディングから変革の浸透まで、一人一人に最適化されたAI活用のジャーニーを届けます。

sentences.english: Amplify the reach of internal communications by displaying Workvivo content on screens across your organization.
sentences.japanese: 社内のディスプレイにワークビブを表示し、コミュニケーションの届く範囲を広げます。

sentences.english: Double-tap on the stories that matter most with newsletters.
sentences.japanese: ニュースレターで一番届けたいストーリーをもう一度。

sentences.english: Collaborate faster with chat, voice, and video calls and AI-powered conversation summaries.
sentences.japanese: チャット、音声、ビデオツーはAIによる会話の要約で、コラボレーションはもっとスピーディーに。

sentences.english: Ask HQ anything and get instant answers from across your connected systems.
sentences.japanese: HQに聞けば連携したシステム全体から答えがすぐに見つかります。

sentences.english: Then go further and take action, all without leaving HQ.
sentences.japanese: 次のアクションまでHQを離れる必要はありません。

sentences.english: From ask to answer to job done.
sentences.japanese: 質問から回答へ、そして完了まで。

sentences.english: One app with multiple context-aware experiences giving every employee access to the right tools, resources, and information, no matter where they are.
sentences.japanese: 一つのアプリに状況に応じた複数の体験を、どこにいても必要なツール、リソース、情報にアクセスできます。

sentences.english: Bring it to life with a library of ready-made widgets, from business tools and integrations, to news, culture, and employee resources.
sentences.japanese: 業務ツールや各種連携からニュース、カルチャー、社員向けリソースまで。すぐに使えるウィジェットで思いのままに。

sentences.english: Or create your own with our AI Widget Builder.
sentences.japanese: AIウィジェットビルダーで自分だけの一つを。

sentences.english: Publish polished content in minutes with our AI-powered page creation.
sentences.japanese: AIによるページ作成で洗練されたコンテンツを数分で公開。

sentences.english: Turn scattered information into structured, searchable knowledge hubs.
sentences.japanese: 散在していた情報を整理された検索、可能なナレッジハブへ。

sentences.english: See what's working, understand your people, and act on real data, not guesswork, with advanced analytics.
sentences.japanese: 高度な分析機能で何がうまくいっているかを可視化し、社員を理解し、勘ではなく実際のデータで動く。

sentences.english: Run engagement surveys that actually get answered and measure what matters most to your people.
sentences.japanese: きちんと回答が集まるサーベイで、社員にとって大切なことを測定します。

sentences.english: Go beyond the numbers with AI-powered insights that uncover trends, reveal what's driving engagement, and highlight where to focus next.
sentences.japanese: AIインサイトが数字の先を明らかに。傾向を捉えエンゲージメントを動かす要因と次の一手を示します。

sentences.english: Give managers instant visibility into team sentiment so they can take action with confidence, wherever they are.
sentences.japanese: マネージャーはチームの状態をすぐに把握でき、自信を持って行動を起こせます。

sentences.english: From the moment employees share feedback to the moment they see meaningful change, it all happens here, in HQ.
sentences.japanese: 場所を問わず、フィードバックが届いた瞬間から変化を実感するまで。すべてがここHQで完結します。

sentences.english: Let AI do the hard work of building your survey so you can jump straight into the results.
sentences.japanese: サーベイ作成の手間はAIにお任せ。すぐに結果の確認から始められます。

sentences.english: All your favorite tools, one experience layer, everything your people need, right inside HQ.
sentences.japanese: 使い慣れたツールのすべてを一つの体験レイヤーに。必要なものは全てHQに。

sentences.english: Manage your employee experience with confidence through powerful self-service admin tools and feature toggles.
sentences.japanese: セルフサービス型の管理と機能のオンオフで、社員エクスペリエンスを安心して運用。

sentences.english: Enable AI with confidence with granular controls, permissions, and governance built in.
sentences.japanese: きめ細かな制御権限設定、ガバナンスを標準搭載。安心してAIを活用できます。

sentences.english: Powered by Zoom AI technology, enterprise-grade intelligence built into every experience.
sentences.japanese: ZoomのAIを基盤に、エンタープライズグレードの知能をすべての体験に。

sentences.english: The employee experience platform your people actually use, trusted by the world's biggest brands.
sentences.japanese: 社員が本当に使うエクスペリエンスプラットフォーム。世界を代表するブランドに選ばれています。

sentences.english: This is Workvivo HQ.
sentences.japanese: これがWorkvivoHQです。
